claims.claim_text: 把多個 LLM 用 routing、voting 或 mixture-of-agents 併起來，準確率上限被一個叫 beta 的量卡死——也就是所有模型同時答錯同一題的比率。實測數學任務 beta 約 0.052，但傳統用 pairwise 相關係數 rho 估出來只有 0.023，低估了約 2.5 倍。
claims.location: AI #02「多模型併用的共同失誤天花板」
claims.evidence: accuracy cannot exceed one minus beta, where beta is the rate at which every model is wrong on the same query ... On open-ended mathematics: observed beta is 0.052 versus 0.023 under the full 67-model Gaussian copula, about 2.5 times underpricing ... the usual diagnostic, average pairwise error correlation rho, cannot identify beta
claims.note: Source title 'When Does Combining Language Models Help? A Co-Failure Ceiling on Routing, Voting, and Mixture-of-Agents Across 67 Frontier Models'. beta 0.052 vs 0.023, ~2.5x and rho cannot identify beta all confirmed verbatim. The 67-model span is also confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 沒有夠強的 query 級路由訊號，組合模型幾乎贏不過單一最強模型。
claims.location: AI #02「多模型併用的共同失誤天花板」
claims.evidence: On checkable tasks in our pool, combining models rarely beats the single best model without a strong query-level routing signal.
claims.note: Lede '幾乎贏不過' matches source 'rarely beats'; both scope to checkable/math tasks. No hedge inflation.

claims.claim_text: doubleword 用 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 等 18 個 benchmark，量開源權重模型到底落後閉源幾個月。單看一個榜外推，會得出「年底就追上」的樂觀結論；多榜一起看，差距其實穩定在約 5 個月、甚至在拉大。
claims.location: AI #07「開源權重落後閉源幾個月」
claims.evidence: The Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index alone suggests ... the gap shrinks to 0 months around December 3rd 2026 ... examining 18 different benchmarks ... a line of best fit ... is almost completely flat, at just under 5 months for the entire period.
claims.note: 18 benchmarks, single-benchmark optimistic catch-up (~year-end / Dec 3 2026), multi-benchmark ~5 months flat all confirmed. 'gap widening' is supported by 'moderate increase over time in their gaps' for most datasets.

claims.claim_text: 一篇論文提出 Reboot，把 C 寫的直譯器幾乎全自動翻成 safe Rust。手法是 feature reduction……六個直譯器（6k 到 23k 行 C）只要 1 到 11 次人工介入就全數通過測試。mujs 的案例直接消掉了 heap buffer overflow 與 use-after-free 這類記憶體漏洞。
claims.location: SYSTEMS #01「Reboot：把 C 直譯器翻成 safe Rust」
claims.evidence: We have translated six interpreters ranging from 6k to 23k lines of C code to safe Rust, with each translation requiring only 1 to 11 brief user interventions. ... A security case study on mujs shows that memory vulnerabilities such as heap buffer overflows and use-after-free present in C are eliminated in the safe Rust translation.
claims.note: Title 'Mostly Automatic Translation of Language Interpreters from C to Safe Rust'. Six interpreters, 6k-23k lines, 1-11 interventions, feature reduction, multi-agent orchestration, and mujs eliminating heap buffer overflow + use-after-free all confirmed verbatim.

claims.claim_text: Zig 的 devlog 更新兩件事：重新定義 @bitCast 的語義，以及推進 LLVM 後端……@bitCast 過去在某些位元重排情境語義含糊，這次把行為釘清楚。
claims.evidence: The June 25th devlog, authored by Matthew Lugg, addresses: LLVM backend integer lowering improvements; Redefinition of @bitCast semantics ... the builtin is now defined in terms of the bits which logically represent a type.
claims.note: The cited URL anchors to #2026-06-25; that entry covers @bitCast semantics redefinition and LLVM backend, both confirmed.

claims.claim_text: Zig 的 6 月 25 日 devlog 重新定義了 @bitCast 的語義：過去在某些位元重排情境下行為含糊，這次把它釘清楚。同一條目也記了 LLVM 後端的數項改進。
claims.evidence: Yes, the 2026-06-25 entry addresses both @bitCast semantics redefinition and LLVM backend improvements. It does NOT cover SPIR-V ... the builtin is now defined in terms of the bits which logically represent a type ... changing how the LLVM backend lowers non-ABI integer types ... was demonstrably successful at restoring missed optimizations.
claims.note: Round 2: lede corrected to remove the SPIR-V/GPU misattribution. The 2026-06-25 entry now matches the lede exactly — @bitCast semantics redefinition plus several LLVM backend improvements, with SPIR-V correctly absent from this entry. Round-1 verdict was unverifiable (citation drift); now supported.

claims.claim_text: AWS Lambda 推出 microVM——一個基於 Firecracker 的新運算原語，提供 VM 級隔離，又能從快照近乎即啟、閒置時自動 suspend／resume 並保留記憶體與磁碟狀態……上限 16 vCPU、32GB 記憶體、單次最長 8 小時。
claims.evidence: Lambda MicroVMs are powered by Firecracker ... virtual machine level isolation ... launches and idle resumes both achieve near-instant startup latency ... During idle periods, a MicroVM can be suspended – with memory and disk state intact – and resumed ... up to 16 vCPUs, 32 GB of memory, and 32 GB of disk per MicroVM ... up to 8 hours of total runtime.
claims.note: Firecracker, VM-level isolation, near-instant snapshot start, suspend/resume with memory+disk preserved, 16 vCPU / 32GB / 8 hours all confirmed. '單次最長 8 小時' matches 'up to 8 hours of total runtime'.

claims.claim_text: chrismorgan 寫了一份務實的 font-family 設定建議：從 system font stack、fallback 鏈，到 CJK 與等寬字面該怎麼鋪，給出可直接抄進 CSS 的設定。重點不是追時髦字型，而是在沒有自訂 webfont 時，怎麼讓各平台都拿到合理的預設。
claims.location: WEB #05「一份務實的 font-family 建議」
claims.evidence: There are no web-safe fonts; none are available across all major platforms ... Always include monospace if you want the text monospaced ... UI fonts are designed for short UI texts, not longform content [accessibility problems, particularly for CJK ... on Windows] ... why not just use whatever font the user has?
claims.note: Page does give practical font-family guidance covering generic/system fallback, monospace, CJK and the no-webfont default. Confirmed.

claims.claim_text: SwiftLaTeX 把完整的 LaTeX 排版引擎用 WebAssembly 搬進瀏覽器，純前端就能編譯出 PDF，不必架後端 TeX 服務。
claims.location: WEB #06「LaTeX.wasm：瀏覽器裡的 LaTeX 引擎」
claims.evidence: PdfTeX and XeTeX written in 100% WebAssembly and run in browsers ... 100% Browser ... compileLaTeX() ... returns PDF binary and compilation log.
claims.note: Full LaTeX engine (PdfTeX/XeTeX) in WebAssembly, client-side PDF compilation, no backend required all confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 一篇 arXiv 論文提出 Moebius，在服務 mixture-of-expert 模型時，依負載於執行期無縫切換 runtime 平行策略，不必重新啟動服務……Moebius 把切換成本壓到能線上做。
claims.location: INFRA #08「Moebius：執行期切換 MoE 平行策略」
claims.evidence: Moebius: Serving Mixture-of-Expert Models with Seamless Runtime Parallelism Switch ... The optimal choice depends on the number of in-flight requests: TP is faster at low concurrency, whereas EP wins at high concurrency ... Each switch completes in 215-434 ms, allowing the system to adapt to changing loads while maintaining service availability.
claims.note: Title and core claim (seamless runtime parallelism switch for MoE serving, load-dependent optimum, low-cost online switch ~215-434ms with no restart) confirmed verbatim.

claims.claim_text: grack 拆解了一次疑似國家級、而且是失敗的攻擊：逐步還原攻擊鏈在哪些環節露餡、防守端又是怎麼接住的。
claims.evidence: Anatomy of a Failed (Nation-State?) Attack ... this was targeted, had a pretty convincing cover story with a fake persona, multiple fake websites with stolen history, and a patient timeline ... Embedded in the typescript+5.9.2.patch file ... there is a base64-blob self-executing obfuscation stub [caught before execution].
claims.note: Post is a dissection of a suspected ('?') nation-state attack that failed; the lede's hedge '疑似' matches the source's own question-marked framing. No hedge inflation.

claims.claim_text: ebellani 用一套完整的雙分錄記帳系統論證：很多人一遇到稽核、高寫入、複雜約束、分析查詢就急著加專用元件，但 PostgreSQL 18 內建的功能其實接得住。手法包括 temporal table 做稽核、constraint trigger 上業務規則、HOT update 調寫入，並把工作集塞進 shared_buffers 直接省掉外部快取層。
claims.location: BACKEND #10「你需要的其實只有 PostgreSQL」
claims.evidence: System-time temporal tables give you a complete, automatic audit trail of every transfer status transition ... constraint triggers keeping them as declarative as possible ... HOT updates are important because status transitions ... are common operations and we want to minimize write amplification ... fit the working set comfortably in modern cloud database servers ... All of this runs on a single vanilla PostgreSQL 18 instance with standard extensions available on RDS.
claims.note: Round 2: lede corrected to drop the earlier false queue/cache/full-text-search enumeration. The new lede's load-bearing mechanisms all match the source: temporal tables for auditing, constraint triggers for business rules, HOT updates for write throughput, working set in shared_buffers avoiding an external cache, on PostgreSQL 18. (Minor texture: the source uses a balance-ledger accounting model rather than strictly bidirectional double-entry, but '雙分錄記帳系統' is descriptive framing, not the load-bearing assertion, which is fully supported.) Round-1 verdict was unverifiable (citation drift); now supported.
